quote: Kenny is unavailable right now. Did you just miss a call?
stewart_read: Rep never re-established who he is, what company he represents, or referenced a form/lead source clearly to the customer beyond implying solar interest — legitimacy is thin for a customer who thought she was speaking to a different named person.
alternative_hypothesis: Reactive read is more supported: rep skipped straight to qualifying without confirming the ION name or lead context explicitly.
coaching_implication: Even on a callback, restate company name and reason for the call clearly before diving into qualifiers.

quote: And then is there anyone else on the title of the home with you?
stewart_read: Customer confirms her son is also on the title, but rep never circles back to confirm the son will be present for the appointment.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic deferral is possible if son is a minor or not truly a co-decider, but the customer's answer was unclear ("I guess so") and warranted a follow-up.
coaching_implication: Per protocols.adult_child_decision_maker, confirm whether the co-owner needs to be on the appointment call.

quote: Would you have a second to pull that up and send it over to me?
stewart_read: Bill is requested purely as a document to build the estimate; rep never asks about the bill amount or reflects it back as pain, despite the bill_amount step being skipped entirely per verified events.
coaching_implication: Even if collecting the bill electronically, ask the dollar amount verbally first to create an anchor before the document even arrives.

quote: Okay. Can you resend this? I don't know why it it got deleted.
stewart_read: Second email attempt fails; rep pivots to texting the link as a backup within about a minute, which matches the schema's guidance to pivot on tech friction quickly.
coaching_implication: Good recovery — worth reinforcing as an example of the right pivot speed (text backup) rather than burning the full call on one channel.

quote: is there something you can do over the phone or online, you know, over Zoom?
stewart_read: This is a soft channel objection to the in-home visit; rep first concedes ("Over the phone would be better") before reversing to push in-person, an inconsistent handling that could have confused the customer.
alternative_hypothesis: Reactive read: rep answered reflexively then corrected himself rather than executing a deliberate reframe.
coaching_implication: Anchor the in-person value proposition immediately rather than agreeing then walking it back — confusing sequencing risks no-show or distrust.

quote: Yeah. But it's my son. I guess so. Your son. I make it a good one. Yeah.
stewart_read: A co-owner (son) is identified but never invited to or confirmed for the appointment.
coaching_implication: Follow the adult-child protocol: explicitly ask if the son should be present for the design review.
